sections: DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS RELEASE NOTES
text:
DUCKS ON THE POND CARDS RELEASE NOTES

Latest: November 2026 (test harness release), release 0.7

These notes list what changed in each release, newest first. Dates are when the change went in. Version numbers were assigned to group the changes and are not shown in the Application. For what the Application can do overall, see the Capabilities Summary (capabilities-summary.txt).

RELEASE 0.7, 2026-11-08: SEARCH THE HELP DOCUMENTS

New - The Search page and POST /api/search now search the Ducks Corpus, this Application's own help documents.

Removed - The Trailhead Supply Co. course documents, which search used before. They were about a different business and could return unrelated answers.

RELEASE 0.6, 2026-11-07: HELP DOCUMENTS

New - The Ducks Corpus: help documents for the card application, including the User's Guide, Customer Service Policy, Capabilities Summary and FAQ. Further documents (Terms of Use, Privacy Notice, Serial-Number Dispute Procedure, Collector Handbook, Glossary, Security and Incident Response, and a sample Pricing Guide) follow.

RELEASE 0.5, 2026-11-03: SEARCH QUALITY CHECKS

Changes (behind the scenes) - Added a fixed set of test questions with known answers, and a scoresheet, to measure how well search and answers perform. - Added checks that answers decline politely when the documents do not cover a question, and that instructions hidden inside a document are ignored. - The developer question-answering tool can now save a log of each run.

No change to the pages collectors use.

RELEASE 0.4, 2026-10-31: QUESTION ANSWERING (DEVELOPER TOOL)

New - A command-line tool for developers (npm run ask) that answers questions from the reference documents using Anthropic's Claude model, quoting its sources. It is not part of the web Application yet.

RELEASE 0.3, 2026-10-25 TO 2026-10-26: SEARCH

New - Search page. Ask a question in plain words and see the three closest passages from the reference documents, with source, section and a similarity score. - "Not in the documents" is shown when nothing scores at least 0.33, with the best score found. - Searches can be shared by copying the page address (/search?q=your+question). - POST /api/search for the same search from other clients. Questions can be up to 500 characters.

sections: KNOWN ISSUES AND NOT YET AVAILABLE
text:
Ask a question in plain words and see the three closest passages from the reference documents, with source, section and a similarity score. - "Not in the documents" is shown when nothing scores at least 0.33, with the best score found. - Searches can be shared by copying the page address (/search?q=your+question). - POST /api/search for the same search from other clients. Questions can be up to 500 characters.

Fixed - When the database is reachable but not set up yet, pages now say so, instead of showing a general error. - Search now works on the hosted site, not only on developer machines.

RELEASE 0.2, 2026-10-24: THE TEST HARNESS

New - The first working pages: Home, Catalog, My collection, Wishlist, Trades, Reports and Admin, as unstyled forms and tables. - Test user picker: switch between Alice and Bob (collectors) and Carol (admin). Test login can be turned off per environment. - Catalog of sets, parallels, cards and variants, with automatic Base parallels and Base variants. - Collection tracking with grading, serial numbers, cert numbers, prices, tradeable and for-sale settings, sales and undoing a sale. - Serial-number protection with admin review of conflicts. - Wishlist with matching in both directions. - Trades: propose, accept, decline, counter, cancel and complete. - Reports: summary, inventory, for sale and sold. - Database row-level security, so collectors can change only their own data. - Page view and visitor counts (Vercel Web Analytics).

Changes (behind the scenes) - Structured server logs for every request, with secrets removed before anything is written. - Database connections always check the server's certificate.

RELEASE 0.1, 2026-10-23: FIRST BUILD

New - The Application's foundation on Next.js, React and TypeScript, hosted on Vercel with a Postgres database on Neon. - GET /api/health: reports whether the Application and database are up.

Fixed - A security update to a third-party library (zod).

section: KNOWN ISSUES AND NOT YET AVAILABLE
sections: KNOWN ISSUES AND NOT YET AVAILABLE
text:
New - The Application's foundation on Next.js, React and TypeScript, hosted on Vercel with a Postgres database on Neon. - GET /api/health: reports whether the Application and database are up. Fixed - A security update to a third-party library (zod).

KNOWN ISSUES AND NOT YET AVAILABLE

- Sign-in uses test users only. There are no personal accounts yet. - No payments, shipping, card photos or notifications. - No screen for entering market prices, so the Market column is usually blank. - A copy's grade, serial or paid price cannot be edited after it is added. Delete and re-add it (an admin can change a serial). - Catalog entries cannot be edited or deleted from the pages. - Test data may be reset without notice.

COMING NEXT [TO CONFIRM]

- Personal accounts and real sign-in. - Email notifications for trades and serial-number reviews. - Card photos and market-price entry. - A styled interface.
